name: @openrater/scoring
description: Backend scoring service. Imports the ONE rating engine from @openrater/contracts (no Python port) so server-side scoring is byte-identical to the Rate Lab canvas. Deployment-agnostic core behind JobQueue / ResultStore / PlanSource ports; local adapters now (in-memory + Redis + filesystem), AWS adapters later (SQS + S3). See docs/adr/0045-backend-scoring-service.md.
